name: SteelSeries Arctis 5 (OpenRGB protocol)
description: The two ear-cup lights of the first SteelSeries Arctis 5 headset (USB 1038:1250), following OpenRGB's SteelSeriesArctis5Controller (GPL-2.0-or-later); untested on hardware. Only lighting reports are sent: volume, sidetone, microphone and the other headset settings are never touched. The second Arctis 5 (1038:12AA) is driven by HueDeck's own plugins/steelseries-arctis-5, not by this plugin. Protocol notes: docs/hardware/steelseries-arctis.md.
